info.title: AxiomSpec service interface
info.description: Read access to immutable releases for coding agents, and release management for an organization. Every read is a GET on a release named by digest. An answer that is a function of the release alone never changes and can be cached without limit; an answer that also reads the code beside the release (index, lookup, trace, gaps, when the service was started on a repository) carries an ETag and is revalidated, because the digest does not cover the code. A sandbox can allow the service read-only by HTTP method. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents, including INTERNAL_ERROR with status 500 for a defect of the service. Rules: docs/19_SERVICE_INTERFACE.md. Runtime admission and body limits apply to REST and MCP; application overload returns a problem document, while Uvicorn may return a plain 503 before application dispatch. Health probes are transport operations.

post.summary: Build a candidate release from a baseline and edits addressed by ID. The same request always yields the same digest.

201.description: The candidate and its checks. It is held by the store only when it passes them; a refused candidate is returned and changes nothing. A held candidate is still only a candidate until it has its approvals.

STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: configured store paths are not accessible. This is not a full release verdict.

accepted_head.description: The highest release whose own checks and complete baseline chain pass, or null when none passes. A genesis still needs a trusted digest pin; the head is the highest version whatever its status.

Verdict.description: The store verdict on one release and its baseline chain (AX-L-010). Local approvals may pass while status fails or remains unknown because an ancestor is not accepted.

Comparison.description: The G14 comparison of two releases (AX-G-013).

Impact.description: The consumers a provider step reaches (AX-L-011).

held.description: True when the store now holds the candidate. Only a candidate whose status is pass is held.
